flags.message: No record/documents/ directory (and no documents.json) was provisioned for this merits grant-moment cell although the petition, QP, and BIO are public on supremecourt.gov; the snapshot even carries a QPLink. I retrieved the QP and the government's petition (with the Second Circuit opinion appended) myself in forward mode. Not a blocker, but the cell forecast from retrieved rather than provisioned filings, so predictors in this fan-out may not share the same document baseline.

Vehicle note for the evaluator: the government filed No. 26-104 as a hold petition asking the Court to hold it behind Putra v. Lopez-Campos (No. 25-1415, CA6), yet the October 1 order granted only 26-104 and left 25-1415 and Buenrostro-Mendez (No. 26-43, CA5) undisposed. The forecast treats that vehicle choice as a modest signal; it is pre-decision public information, not outcome material.
